Demo logic: below 4 m, monitor. From 4 m, close the barrier and keep the pump on standby. From 5 m, close the barrier and activate the pump.

These thresholds are illustrative. Hardware calibration, independent safety controls, and operator approval are future work.

Model selection

Reproducibility
Data seed 42 · split seed 91 · weights seed 7

What this project demonstrates

Forecast inference, bounded input validation, a baseline comparison, risk classification, and simulated protective responses.

Synthetic test results measure how well the model learns this generator. They do not establish accuracy on real floods. No sensors, weather feed, messaging service, or actuators are connected.
